remarks: Living is easy and luxurious in this RARE offering of an oversized 1180 square foot mint condition, one bedroom in the prestigious Buckingham Condominium. Spacious living room with private terrace, large dining alcove, modern, updated kitchen, terrific closet space with built-ins, renovated bath, all in Stamford's premier condo building. This classic building boasts a heated pool, private gym with sauna, large commons room, library/meeting room, outdoor terrace for quiet or gatherings, underground private parking, guest parking, storage lockers for extra space, full time super, as well as social committee for building/community activities. Prime location in heart of Stamford. Bright light, and nice views. Newly painted. Ready for immediate sale.
